historical_v0_3_policy.reason: v0.3 omitted an independently tuned matched two-stage comparator and a paired confirmatory confidence-bound gate

factorized.definition: support-preserving I-projection with H+Z and C marginals retained

matched_two_stage.definition: p(C) followed by p(H+Z|C), both obtained from the same full posterior table
matched_two_stage.claim_boundary: this algebraically matched decomposition is an intentionally strongest falsifier, not evidence that an empirical learned pipeline has joint-model performance

validation_only_tuning.selection_rule: minimum validation mean consequential cost; ties prefer temperature nearest 1 then lower

confirmatory_execution.factor_matrix_per_seed: 2x2x2 ambiguity x delayed-feedback x open-world actor

paired_confidence_interval.independent_unit: confirmatory RNG seed cluster; average its eight factor cells before resampling
paired_confidence_interval.method: paired deterministic percentile bootstrap over seed-cluster means

consequential_endpoint.decision_time: after registered observations and before evaluator reveals truth

decision_rule.primary_gate: paired lower confidence bound of matched_two_stage_cost - joint_cost is strictly greater than 0.001
